cds.title: Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research, Planning and Assessment)

scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2025-26 from the Common Data Set (G1); the G1 grid is for 2025-26, and the CDS gives April 1 as the date 2026-27 costs will be available. Tuition $56,910, required fees $1,290, food and housing $17,427 (housing $10,095 + 18-meal plan $7,332). Estimated expenses: books $1,500, other $5,040. A freshman laptop bundle of $2,650 is charged in the first fall term only (not included above). Per-credit-hour tuition $1,660 (12-18 credits per term). The CDS prints no separate international tuition. Aid to nonresidents (H6, 2025-26 estimated): institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are both ticked; 188 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid averaging $29,730 (not split by need or merit).

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class): 5,991 applied (4,513 men, 1,478 women), 4,847 admitted, 484 enrolled in the fall snapshot (C1's men and women rows add to 485); the residency rows (in-state, out-of-state, international, unknown 0) add up to the applicant and admit totals, and enrolled 156 + 288 + 37 + 3 = 484. International (nonresident) first-years: 1,036 applied, 805 admitted, 37 enrolled. Early action is non-binding (no early decision); its counts are not reported. The GPA breakdown covers the 474 first-years who reported a GPA (97.9%); lower bands are blank. SAT/ACT are optional: 173 first-years (35.7%) submitted the SAT and 80 (16.5%) the ACT. Undergraduate enrollment (2,160) is B1 'Total all undergraduates' and the nonresident count (191) is the degree-seeking figure from B2 (the CDS does not split the 7 non-degree-seeking undergraduates).

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (C8): test-optional policy in effect; SAT or ACT is 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.
